problem: A tracked redraw or ignored native UI command can stay in the command reader without emitting its completion token, leaving later input waiting indefinitely.
changes: Route tracked no-op and redraw packets through the existing turn-free native command boundary.
Restore server readiness from an exact completion token even when no input-mode packet was emitted.
Drain buffered local no-ops until a command actually owns the engine, while retaining stale-token and prompt guards.
native_build: isolated macOS arm64 C++17, two workers, optimization disabled, hash-bound installed dependency libraries
earlier_attempts: Attempt 1 stopped before compilation when the snapshot tried to rebuild missing dependency submodules. The retry reused already installed, hash-bound static libraries.
Attempt 2 built successfully but stopped at a starting-weapon assertion before the input probe. The final probe uses explicit Conjurer characters without starting weapons.
authorization: Direct user authorization to upload and deploy while preserving saves, followed by explicit force-update authorization. The remaining game exited through its native save command.
